aucune_transaction_periode_selectionnee: No transaction in the selected period.
donnee_pas_encore_recue_confirmation: Data not received yet (automatic confirmation pending)
interac_cheque_virement_comptant_paiemen: (Interac, cheque, transfer, cash…): the payment was entered by hand, so there is no automatic settlement or payout date and no fee. That is normal.
moment_argent_arrive_compte_bancaire: : when the money reaches your bank account.
moment_fonds_disponibles_solde: : when the funds become available in your balance (usually +2 business days in Canada).
paiement_carte_confirmation_pas_arrivee: : a card payment whose settlement or payout confirmation has not arrived yet (usually a few days after the payment).
paiement_saisi_manuellement_admin: Payment entered by hand by the admin
paiement_saisi_manuellement_pas_referenc: Payment entered by hand — no online payment reference
quand_argent_arrive_banque: When the money reaches the bank
utilisez_selecteur_adapter_periode: Use the Filter by selector to fit the period to what you need: payment (GST/QST tax report), settlement (tracking what is available), payout (checking against the bank statement).
